senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; חָמָה to surround, protect, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. חמה) wall, esp. fortification Yeb. 62ᵇ (ref. to Jer. XXXI, 21) בלא ח׳ lives without (moral) protection.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 5b:15">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>שימה חוֹמָתָהּ</he> whose lake is her fortification.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:1">Ib. I, 1</cite> <he>מוקפין ח׳</he> fortified all around; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00337"><he>חוֹמוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:7:1">Cant. R. to V, 7</cite> <he>חוֹמוֹתֶיהָ של וכ׳</he> the walls of; a. e.
